_note: 學習路徑內容建置第7批 #4／6：期間/時間介系詞 prepositions of duration & time（eng.t_mid.prep.duration，會考級／中階）。for＝持續多久（長度）；during＝在某段期間/事件內（during ＋ 名詞）；since＝從某時間點起（常配現在完成式）；by＝某期限之前完成（單次動作的截止點）；until＝持續到某時間點才停；within＝在某段時間之內。誘答以『該介系詞搭配在此語境不合法/意思不符』鎖唯一正解（如 during ＋ 長度、by ＋ 持續動作、for 2019 皆不合法）。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix pdu_）。

units.can_do: 我能依語意選對期間/時間介系詞——for（持續多久）、during（在某段期間/事件內）、since（從某時間點起，常配現在完成式）、by（某期限之前完成）、until（持續到某時間點）、within（在某段時間之內）。
units.situation_group: 介系詞 Prepositions of time and duration
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'for' + a length of time answers 'how long': for two hours, for three weeks.
claims.verification_ref: for ＋ 時間長度（持續多久）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'during' + a noun that names a period or event says when something happens inside it: during the summer, during the movie.
claims.verification_ref: during ＋ 名詞（某段期間/事件內）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'since' + a starting point in time shows when something began and is usually used with the present perfect: I have lived here since 2019.
claims.verification_ref: since ＋ 起始時間點、常配現在完成式；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'by' + a time means 'at this time or earlier' and is used for a single action that must be done before a deadline: Finish it by Friday.
claims.verification_ref: by ＋ 期限（在…之前完成，單次動作）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'until' + a point in time means a situation continues up to that point and then stops: The shop is open until nine.
claims.verification_ref: until ＋ 時間點（持續到…才停）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'within' + a period means 'before the end of that period': Your order will arrive within three days.
claims.verification_ref: within ＋ 一段時間（在…之內）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'for' tells us how long something lasts, so it takes a length of time: for two hours. 'during' tells us when it happens, inside a named period or event, so it takes a noun: during the summer. Use 'for' with a length, 'during' with a name. We cannot say 'during two hours'.
teach.zh_hint: for＝「持續多久」（接時間長度，如 for two hours）。during＝「在某段期間/事件之內」（接名詞，如 during the summer）。注意：for 接長度、during 接名稱——不能說 ×during two hours。

teach.body: We traveled around Europe for three weeks, and during that trip we visited six countries.
teach.zh_hint: 我們在歐洲旅行三週，在那趟旅程中去了六個國家。for ＋ 長度、during ＋ 名詞。

teach.body: 'since' means from a point in time up to now, and often goes with the present perfect (have / has). 'until' means the action keeps going up to a point in time and then stops.
teach.zh_hint: since＝「從某時間點起」，常配現在完成式（have／has）。until＝「持續到某時間點才停」（動作一直進行到那時）。

teach.body: I have known her since kindergarten, and we often chat until late at night.
teach.zh_hint: 我從幼稚園就認識她，我們常聊天聊到深夜。since ＋ 起點配 have、until ＋ 時間點。

teach.body: 'by' means not later than a deadline, the point when a one-time action must be finished: by Friday. 'within' means inside a length of time: within a week means in one week or less.
teach.zh_hint: by＝「在某期限之前（就）完成」（單次動作的截止點，如 by Friday）。within＝「在某段時間之內」（如 within a week＝一週內）。

teach.body: Please send the form back by Friday; you should get a reply within a week.
teach.zh_hint: 請在週五前把表格寄回，你應該會在一週內收到回覆。by ＋ 期限、within ＋ 一段時間。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞（持續多久）：We stayed in Kyoto ____ five days.（我們在京都待了五天）

distractor_rationales.during: during 後面接的是某段期間或事件的名稱（during the holidays），不接「五天」這種長度（×during five days）；長度用 for。
distractor_rationales.since: since 接「起始時間點」（since Monday）配現在完成式；講待了多久（長度）用 for。
distractor_rationales.by: by 接「期限」（by Friday）；講持續的長度用 for。

practice.feedback: 持續多久（長度）用 for：We stayed in Kyoto for five days。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞（在某事件之內）：I fell asleep ____ the long movie.（我在那部很長的電影播放期間睡著了）

distractor_rationales.for: for 接時間長度（for two hours）；這裡是「在那部電影（事件）之內」睡著，用 during ＋ 名詞。
distractor_rationales.by: by 接期限（by nine）；在事件進行中某刻發生用 during。
distractor_rationales.within: within 接一段時間（within a week）表示「在…之內完成」；指在某事件進行期間用 during。

practice.feedback: 在某段期間或事件之內用 during ＋ 名詞：I fell asleep during the long movie。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞（從某時間點起）：I have lived in this town ____ 2019.（我從 2019 年就住在這個鎮上）

distractor_rationales.for: for 接時間長度（for five years）；接「某個起始年份」用 since（×for 2019）。
distractor_rationales.during: during 接某段期間/事件（during 2019 指那一整年內某時發生）；這裡是「從 2019 一直到現在」，配 have lived 用 since。
distractor_rationales.by: by 接期限（by 2019）；講從某年起一直持續用 since。

practice.feedback: 從某時間點一直持續到現在用 since（配現在完成式 have lived）：I have lived here since 2019。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞（某期限之前完成）：You must return the library books ____ next Friday.（你必須在下週五之前把圖書館的書還回去）

distractor_rationales.until: until 表示「動作持續到某時才停」；還書是一次就完成的動作，講「在…之前完成」用 by（×return the books until Friday）。
distractor_rationales.for: for 接時間長度（for a week）；講截止期限用 by。
distractor_rationales.during: during 接某段期間（during next week）；講「在這個期限之前就完成」用 by。

practice.feedback: 單次動作要在某期限之前完成用 by：return the books by next Friday。

practice.stem: 填入正確的介系詞（在一段時間之內）：If you order today, your package will arrive ____ three working days.（今天下單的話，包裹會在三個工作天內送達）

distractor_rationales.for: arrive for three working days 不合語意（for 接持續長度，但送達是一次性動作）；「在三天之內」用 within。
distractor_rationales.since: since 接起始時間點（since Monday）；講「在一段時間之內」用 within。
distractor_rationales.by: by 接明確的時間點/期限（by Friday），不接「三個工作天」這種長度（×by three working days）；用 within。

practice.feedback: 在某段時間之內用 within：your package will arrive within three working days。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I have studied English since last year, and I practice for thirty minutes every day.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：since（起始時間點，配 have studied）和 for（三十分鐘的長度）兩個介系詞有沒有選對，thirty minutes／every day 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。介系詞（by／until／during）輕讀，時間詞稍清楚，句尾下收。

lines.text: Please finish your homework by eight o'clock tonight.
lines.intonation: by eight o'clock 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: The store stays open until ten during the summer holidays.
lines.intonation: until ten／during 平順、句尾下收
